description: React component for a button that triggers running or stopping a SQL query in Apache Superset's SQL Lab, with UI styling, iconography, and logging.

classes.name: RunQueryActionButton
classes.description: React functional component rendering a button to run or stop SQL queries with dynamic icon and tooltip.

methods.name: buildTextAndIcon
methods.description: Determines button text and icon based on whether stop or run action should be shown.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click event to trigger run or stop query actions and logs the event.
